rule:
PHD-MAIN-STAGE3-v1 5.4-2: what the observation-confidence mask filters before training, per B0 image-count condition and for '영상 전체'
(jointbuildgs:dev, CPU; run_cpu3.sh). Per training view of the condition (the per-view maps the fork reads, exported by the s03 run at the
fork's 1024 x 741 grid: prior depth P, tolerance in depth units TAU (tau map = tau / f), the confidence mask A (conf, 0/1), the MVS
geometric depth M (filtered), the patch of each pixel (locmap); the mask-off run's photometric depth Mp = the depth BEFORE filtering):
  GT depth G   = camera-Z z-buffer of the box GT points (stage 0's s61/box_gt gt_points, the aligned GT of every metric) with the 9 x 9 leak
                 filter 0.3 m (the prep task's zbuf / gt_clean rule, s04_gt_v6.zbuf unchanged)
  pixels       = P finite > 0, G finite, Mp finite > 0, the pixel's patch in the B0 evaluation range (region file in_eval)
  image error  = |Mp - G| > TAU (order: 'the photometric depth before filtering is farther than tau from the GT'; the mask removes the MVS
                 depth where it filters, so the photometric depth decides)
  filtered     = image-error pixels with A = 0; missed = image-error pixels with A = 1
  missed split = r = |M - P| / TAU (the judgment's own height conversion: TAU is tau / f of the pixel): r < 1 (tolerance band: the loss
                 does not pull), 1 <= r <= k (pull band: the prior pulls), r > k (the judgment releases the prior); k = the conflict
                 threshold (LoD2 1 tau, ALS 2 tau; LoD2's middle branch is empty by construction)
Per condition: totals, roof-like / wall-like (the patch kind), and per region code (code_ext_v3 of the condition's region file).
  python mask_s3.py [<key> ...]      (default: B0_full and the six conditions)  -> S3/prep/mask.json, .md
